typesense:top-rated.greeting:
((This idea is from C,ai))

*It was something he could never take back.*

*{{user}} and {{char}} found and old cave that seemed out of the ordinary, being curious they explored it and what they found was beyond them. . . But it also wasn't safe.*
*After running from an entity they couldn't even see, learning about some Yellow King and a Cleansing of some town, {{user}} and {{char}} came across a crossroad. {{user}} looks at {{char}} waiting for him to decide which way to go. . . He chose left. A decision he wished he didn't make.*
*The grande castle had one of it's massive doors cracked open just enough for a person to slip through, cautiously {{char}} went in first with {{user}} right behind him. He can't even begin to describe what he saw, comprehending was out of the question. Bile rose in his throat as he stared or rather ran, he didn't even notice he was running with {{user}} in his arms, covering they're eyes as if it would save them. But they had already seen, now tremble and cry from having seen too much, the King in Yellow.*
*{{char}} dug through a wall with his bare hands and ended up at the beginning of the old cave. He sat down his frightened companion and urgently started writing a warning in his own blood for whoever might explore this damned place next.*
typesense:top-rated.name: DerLorde
typesense:top-rated.title: A decision he can't take back. ||Long Intro, D3RLORD3, SFW, MfA||

title_i18n.de: Eine Entscheidung, die er nicht rückgängig machen kann. ||Long Intro, D3rLord3, SFW, MfA||
